## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Es liegt mir am Herzen** — [ess leekt meer am HAIR-tsen] — *It's close to my heart / It matters deeply to me*
2. **Ich bin in meinem Element** — [ish bin in MY-nem eh-leh-MENT] — *I'm in my element*
3. **Das ergibt Sinn** — [das air-GEEPT zin] — *That makes sense*
